decision.next_action: Freeze one exact bare-soil plot event and epoch from the 3.31 GB publisher sample before download. Selectively retain its raw images, XYZ GCP/CP data, field protocol, dense cloud, precision map, and error log; reject the event if the retained protocol does not prove bare surface semantics or if separate horizontal and vertical CP errors cannot be reproduced from the log.

available_evidence.geometry: AHN4 classified raw LAZ; ground, water, buildings, structures, and other returns are distinct classes.
available_evidence.semantics: BGT/IMGeo OnbegroeidTerreindeel polygons distinguish zand, strand en strandwal, and zandverstuiving.
available_evidence.license: AHN4 CC0; current national BGT CC BY 4.0.
available_evidence.independent_control: An independent control party checks absolute planimetry against independently measured reference objects and absolute height against independently measured reference fields.

blocking_reasons: The documented density implies roughly 0.27-0.32 m mean point spacing and cannot natively resolve the 0.25 m lower edge of B1.
The 5-8 cm systematic and 5 cm stochastic position terms can equal or exceed common B1 agricultural and sand relief.
A convenient national classified corpus is not target evidence when its support and error cannot separate the requested signal.

dataset.title: Structure from motion cross-scale dataset on agricultural areas in eastern Germany over a period of 3.5 years - plot scale, single slope scale, and catchment scale

gate_evidence.raw_and_reconstructable_geometry: The archive publishes raw DSLR/UAV imagery, camera calibration, XYZ GCPs, processed dense PLY/E57 point clouds, point-precision maps, and per-model logs.
gate_evidence.surface_semantics_and_masks: Plot protocols bind each experiment to soil cover, grain-size distribution, tillage, crop type/stage, soil moisture, bulk density, organic carbon, rainfall, discharge, and sediment. The slope was kept vegetation-free by cultivation; ROIs and GCP bounds define the measured surface.
gate_evidence.native_support: The slope workflow retains dense points at 2 mm minimum spacing and chooses a 5 mm supported output grid, far finer than B1.
gate_evidence.control_design: Leica TCRM 1102 XYZ controls have stated 2 mm coordinate accuracy; at least one GCP per reconstruction is excluded from adjustment as an independent CP. Selected experiments also have independent TLS and UAV reference surfaces.
gate_evidence.error_artifact_requirement: The publisher states that every 3D model includes GCP/CP RMSE logs and per-axis point-precision files. A retained event must reproduce separate horizontal and vertical errors from those artifacts before geometry is accepted.

candidates.pass_reason: This is open, reconstructable, millimetre-supported measured geometry with explicit bare agricultural process semantics and independent control. It is eligible for one frozen B1 bare cultivated-loess evidence probe without weakening the final gate.
limitations: Foreign loess and management practices require a later Estonia analogue/OOD decision.
One event cannot satisfy independent site/campaign release splits.
The 3.31 GB sample is the smallest complete publisher unit; no full archive is authorized.
The published aggregate CP errors do not replace reproducing separate horizontal and vertical errors from the retained event log.
